text:
Rina: Nimbus staged a one-dog parade in the lobby today. Photo: http://imgur.com/example1.jpg
Dee: I was there. He escorted everyone to the coffee machine like a tiny fluffy mayor.
Omar: Did he demand extra pats or just salute?
Rina: Both. Plus a ceremonial sniff of each desk plant.
Dee: He also insisted on sitting in the swivel chair and refused to share. No regrets.
karen-bot: Reminder: pets in office must be leashed in common areas.
Omar: Noted. Nimbus complied until the pastry box appeared. Then diplomacy collapsed.
Rina: Will bring a folder of Nimbus headshots to next weeks retro. He deserves a spotlight.
Dee: Vote for Nimbus for Employee of the Month. All in favor say yes.
Omar: Yes.
Rina: Yes.
Dee: Photo dump incoming in 5. Thank you for supporting our fluffy ambassador.
